newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products unchanged, but tone weak.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products unchanged, but tone weak.

text.p: NWE oil products were all unchanged in very thin trading, but, for lighter products at least, the tone was slightly weaker, dealers said.
Public holidays in Britain and the United States left many traders disinclined or unable to do business.
"As ever on these days, it's just a day to get the paperwork done," said one trader typical of many.

Gasoline was unchanged with notional offers at $212 fob, but traders said that level appeared unreachable today after NYMEX's slip late on Friday. A eurograde deal at $212 fob Rotterdam was concluded late afternoon on Friday.
"The U.S. was not very convincing on Friday, so, if we do see any deals, they might be a shade lower," one trader said.
Heating oil was steady. The lack of IPE gas oil futures trading effectively killed off any chance of deals.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were quoted at $80/$82 fob Rotterdam, broadly unchanged from Friday's close. Initial estimates for bunker volumes were low.
